statement_en: For each $\varepsilon > 0$, define $$A_{n,\varepsilon}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq\varepsilon\}.$$ If for every $\varepsilon > 0$ one has $$\sum_{n\geq1}\mu(A_{n,\varepsilon})<\infty,$$ then $$\mu\left(\limsup_{n\to\infty}A_{n,\varepsilon}\right)=0,\quad \forall \varepsilon>0,$$ and hence $$f_n(x) \to f(x) \text{ a.e. }x.$$
